offer.text: My child keeps asking after the river. I haven't the time — but you might bring them four cooked cod and share a meal by the water? They'd treasure it.

accept.text: They'll talk your ear off about minnows. Thank you for the patience.

decline.text: Maybe when the days are longer. They'll understand.

in_progress.text: Has my child had their fish supper yet?

ready.text: Cooked cod, shared by the river — just what they wanted.

complete.text: They came home grinning ear to ear, smelling of riverweed. You gave them a fine afternoon.
